children: Plains All American Pipeline L.P. (PAA) filed a Form 8K - Other Events - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 09, 2026.
The following pro forma financial information, which gives effect to the Transactions as if they had been consummated on January 1, 2025, is provided in Exhibit 99.1 attached hereto:
· Unaudited Pro Forma Condensed Statement of Combined Operations for the year ended December 31, 2025 and the notes thereto.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1070423/000110465926105984/tm2624813d1_8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1070423/000110465926105984/0001104659-26-105984-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
